fixed_components.late_recovery: log(C8/C6), last two30m bars; no time-window optimization
fixed_components.early_volume_reclaim: sum(Vj*sign(C8-Cj),j1..6)/sum(Vj,j1..6); proxy close levels, not VWAP or order flow

labels.return_1: T signal, entry Open[T+1], exit Open[T+1+h]; downside uses Low[T+1:T+h], max(0,1-minLow/entryOpen)
labels.return_3: T signal, entry Open[T+1], exit Open[T+1+h]; downside uses Low[T+1:T+h], max(0,1-minLow/entryOpen)
labels.return_5: T signal, entry Open[T+1], exit Open[T+1+h]; downside uses Low[T+1:T+h], max(0,1-minLow/entryOpen)
labels.downside_1: T signal, entry Open[T+1], exit Open[T+1+h]; downside uses Low[T+1:T+h], max(0,1-minLow/entryOpen)
labels.downside_3: T signal, entry Open[T+1], exit Open[T+1+h]; downside uses Low[T+1:T+h], max(0,1-minLow/entryOpen)
labels.downside_5: T signal, entry Open[T+1], exit Open[T+1+h]; downside uses Low[T+1:T+h], max(0,1-minLow/entryOpen)

primary: return3/5 after next open, paired 1/3/5-day risk; return1 is declared auxiliary to detect only short-lived effect; never treat next open gap as tradable return
price_basis: Original HFQ_RESEARCH/2019-12-31 anchor0.2803; no cash dividend overlay; public conversion exact-checked
availability: all eight T30m bars complete, original dailyT17 policy; no independently verified historical publication/revision times
warmup: New two components available each full day; old energy20 controls have first19 missing as published, not filled
opportunity: C8880 entry_eligible original state-dependent ex-ante subset for auxiliary within-scope tests; main test is full pool

label_contract.negative_gap_next: Not tested: next open gap is already realized before proposed entry
label_contract.maturity_columns: label_end_<label>; first test signal strictly after train label maturity

statistics.correlation: Spearman average ties; partial rank IC uses OLS residuals with intercept and all fourteen controls; residual norm <=1e-10 of original centered-rank norm is explained/unavailable
statistics.non_overlap: h+1 phases fixed by original full signal index positions before finite/opportunity filtering

bootstrap.sampling: overlapping full-time-axis blocks, uniform starts, truncate to original length; filter opportunity after sampling
bootstrap.interval: 2.5/97.5% linear quantiles; at least 400 valid replicates
bootstrap.scope: full-pool and opportunity-pool only; descriptive, no search-selection correction

walk_forward.train: 2020 <= signal year < test year AND label_end_label < first actual test-year signaldate
walk_forward.groups: train feature Q25/Q75 linear; test low <= Q25, high >= Q75; original label means
walk_forward.ridge: rank features via train empirical CDF midpoint ties; original target; intercept unpenalized; alpha=10
walk_forward.common_model_rows: all 16 feature columns finite, target finite, training target mature; identical model rows
walk_forward.baseline: training target mean on identical training rows; compare test MSE and Spearman IC

statistics.scope: all rows and optional original strategy ex-ante eligibility; no profitable-row selection
limitations: Already-seen development pool; chronological pseudo-out-of-sample, not sealed independent validation.
No hyperparameter search; all labels, years, phases, components and failures retained.
Future labels never enter feature columns, ECDF, thresholds, or fitting before maturity.
Intervals are descriptive diagnostics and do not correct development-pool selection bias.

stop: No stable incremental post-open return evidence: stop these fixed components. No inverted direction/time-window/threshold search to rescue failed hypothesis. Positive local evidence is retained.
next_policy: Only sufficient incremental evidence permits new independent opportunity expression with public binary SRT and full account validation; no trade deletion inference
limitations: Seen development pool, annual chronological prediction not sealed validation; overlaps and group ties disclosed; labels not fees-inclusive or executable account profit
